anomalies: No text addressed to an AI or agent was encountered on any page opened.
CEN catalogue pages label Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 as 'Directive 2024/1781' (catalogue field naming, not a different act).

Date-label trap: the CEN/CLC/JTC 24 list page calls the DAV 'Publication date' (2026-05-27 / 2026-09-16), while each project page has a separate DOP (2026-11-30 / 2027-03-31), which is the national-implementation deadline.

Title mismatch between CEN catalogue and OJ Annex for EN 18221:2026 ('... and data persistence' vs '... and persistence') and for EN 18222:2026 ('... for the product passport lifecycle ...' vs '... for product passport lifecycle ...').

Capitalisation is inconsistent within the series in both official sources: 'Digital product passport' for EN 18216, 18219, 18220, 18221, 18239, 18246 and 'Digital Product Passport' for EN 18222 and 18223.
Decision (EU) 2026/1736 recital 3 says the standards were drafted by 'CEN, Cenelec and ETSI'; the CEN catalogue attributes them to CEN/CLC/JTC 24.

Secondary sources lag the official catalogue for EN 18239 / EN 18246 (formal-vote and 'Draft' statuses still shown); a Commission news item of 2026-07-20 speaks of 'harmonised parts' of the standards while the Annex lists whole references without restrictions.
Cellar RDF for 32026D1736 exposes the generic 'date' property with three values (2026-07-14, 2026-07-15, 9999-12-31); the typed date properties are unambiguous.
WebFetch returns model-summarised page content, not raw HTML; one SPARQL result was announced as 30 rows but 29 were listed. Exact strings should be re-checked by a human before being hard-coded.
The UNI news item's hyperlink for UNI CEI EN 18223:2026 reportedly points to the UNI CEI EN 18219:2026 URL.
